documents.title: Selective control of HLA-DRB1 and HLA-DQA1 transcription through DR/DQ super enhancer microelements.
meta: Majumder, Parimal; Lee, Joshua; Butler, Royce; Scharer, Christopher D; Boss, Jeremy M
documents.summary: 该文研究MHC-II基因的超级增强子微元件调控，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
documents.abstract: MHC-II gene expression requires promoter-proximal and distal organizing elements. A super enhancer located between the HLA-DR and -DQ genes was dissected into five microdomains (regions A-E) to define its mechanism of action. Regions A and B were required for maximal expression of HLA-DQA1. Region A facilitated HLA-DQA1 expression and substituted for region B in its absence, as well as mediating longer-range interactions with distal CTCF sites. Region D modulated HLA-DRB1 through specific 3D chromatin interactions, whereas a local insulator element (XL9) broadly interacted with the SE. Through deletion of HLA-DRB1 proximal-promoter elements, HLA-DQ expression increased by co-opting interactions with region D, indicating that competition between microelements regulates the absolute levels of MHC-II genes. Together, these data define an additional layer of control for MHC-II genes encoded in one of the most polymorphic and disease-associated regions of the human genome. MHC-II基因表达需要启动子近端和远端的组织元件。位于HLA-DR和-DQ基因之间的一个超级增强子被解析为五个微结构域（区域A-E），以定义其作用机制。区域A和B是HLA-DQA1最大表达所必需的。区域A促进HLA-DQA1表达，并在区域B缺失时替代其功能，同时介导与远端CTCF位点的更长程相互作用。区域D通过特定的3D染色质相互作用调节HLA-DRB1，而一个局部绝缘子元件（XL9）与SE广泛相互作用。通过删除HLA-DRB1近端启动子元件，HLA-DQ表达通过共选区域D的相互作用而增加，表明微元件之间的竞争调节MHC-II基因的绝对水平。综合来看，这些数据定义了人类基因组中最多态性和疾病相关区域之一编码的MHC-II基因的额外调控层次。

documents.title: Genetic mechanisms of mitotic error in 840,853 blood genomes
meta: Si Y; Kamitaki N; Tang D; Loh P
documents.summary: 该文研究血液基因组中嵌合非整倍体的遗传机制，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联，但涉及染色体分离和基因组变异，可借鉴其分析方法。
documents.abstract: Mosaic aneuploidies in leukocytes are commonly detectable in aging individuals. Here, we studied inherited genetic influences on susceptibility to such aneuploidies by precisely quantifying chromosomal ploidy from whole-genome sequencing read-depth in 840,853 individuals. This approach revealed autosomal gains in ~70,000 individuals (7-fold more than previous data sets) and ubiquitous loss of the X chromosome in females and loss of Y in males, each of which exhibited >50% heritability. Genome-wide association analyses of 12 mosaic aneuploidies identified >800 common inherited influences on the generation and proliferation of aneuploid cells. Variants in mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint genes consistently affected aneuploidy of most chromosomes, whereas a missense variant in PMF1 (which encodes a subunit of the outer kinetochore) associated with increased segregation fidelity of some chromosomes at the expense of others. Structural variation within multiple chromosomes associated with allele-specific effects on missegregation rates. An inherited hybrid centromere formed by an ancient recombination of 22q with 13p—generating the largest common structural variant in the human genome—associated with 4-fold greater risk of chromosome 22 gain. Abundant copy number and sequence variation in two X-linked CTCF-binding repeat arrays, ICCE and DXZ4 , associated with a 4-fold range in the likelihoods of different X chromosomes to be lost. These results show how genetic risk of chromosomal gains and losses varies greatly across chromosomes and across people, providing instruments for assessing the effects of mosaic aneuploidies on health. 白细胞中的嵌合体非整倍体（mosaic aneuploidies）在衰老个体中普遍可检测到。本研究通过精确量化840,853名个体的全基因组测序读深（whole-genome sequencing read-depth）中的染色体倍性（chromosomal ploidy），探讨了遗传因素对此类非整倍体易感性的影响。该方法在约70,000名个体中检测到常染色体获得（比先前数据集多7倍），并发现女性中X染色体的普遍缺失及男性中Y染色体的普遍缺失，每种情况均表现出超过50%的遗传力（heritability）。对12种嵌合体非整倍体的全基因组关联分析（genome-wide association analyses）识别出超过800个影响非整倍体细胞生成与增殖的常见遗传因素。有丝分裂纺锤体组装检查点（mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint）基因的变异一致地影响大多数染色体的非整倍体，而PMF1（编码外着丝粒亚基）中的一个错义变异（missense variant）与某些染色体分离保真度（segregation fidelity）的增加相关，但以其他染色体的分离保真度为代价。多个染色体内部的结构变异（structural variation）与错误分离率（missegregation rates）的等位基因特异性效应（allele-specific effects）相关。一个由22q与13p的古老重组形成的遗传性杂合着丝粒（inherited hybrid centromere）——产生了人类基因组中最大的常见结构变异——与染色体22获得的风险增加4倍相关。两个X连锁的CTCF结合重复序列阵列（CTCF-binding repeat arrays）ICCE和DXZ4中丰富的拷贝数变异（copy number variation）和序列变异（sequence variation），与不同X染色体丢失可能性的4倍范围相关。这些结果表明，染色体获得与丢失的遗传风险在不同染色体之间以及不同个体之间差异显著，为评估嵌合体非整倍体对健康的影响提供了工具。

documents.title: A lipoprotein-responsive circular RNA, circCTCF, couples extracellular lipid availability to mTOR signaling via ACSL5 in triple-negative breast cancer.
meta: Zhang, Yuanyuan; Liu, Zhengyi; Su, Xuanyi; Hu, Xinyuan; Zhang, Qing; Zhang, Huiyang; Shicao, Duan; Cheng, Linna; Zhang, Xu Dong; Liu, Xiaoying; Chen, Song; Thorne, Rick F
documents.summary: 该文研究circCTCF环状RNA在乳腺癌中调控脂质代谢和mTOR信号，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
documents.abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an aggressive subtype with limited therapeutic options. While metabolic reprogramming is a hallmark of cancer, most studies have focused on cell-intrinsic alterations in glucose and amino acid metabolism, with comparatively little attention paid to how cancer cells sense and respond to extracellular lipid availability. Here, through an unbiased transcriptomic and circRNA profiling screen under lipoprotein-deprived conditions, we identify circCTCF, a circular RNA derived from the CTCF gene, as a lipoprotein-responsive regulator of lipid metabolism and proliferation in TNBC. circCTCF is significantly downregulated upon lipid withdrawal, and its depletion impairs cell growth while promoting lipid droplet accumulation. Conversely, circCTCF overexpression enhances proliferation and suppresses lipid storage. Mechanistically, circCTCF binds the RNA-binding protein G3BP2 through its back-splice junction sequence to stabilize ACSL5 mRNA, thereby sustaining ACSL5 expression, phosphatidic acid (PA) levels, and mTOR signaling. ACSL5 overexpression rescues PA and mTOR activity in circCTCF-deficient cells, establishing a linear circCTCF-ACSL5-PA-mTOR axis. Furthermore, circCTCF associates with G3BP2-positive stress granules upon heat shock, suggesting a potential link between this metabolic axis and stress-induced RNA regulatory networks. Collectively, these findings establish circCTCF as a critical node coupling extracellular lipid cues to intracellular metabolic control and identify the circCTCF-ACSL5-PA-mTOR axis as a potential therapeutic vulnerability in TNBC. 三阴性乳腺癌（triple-negative breast cancer, TNBC）是一种侵袭性亚型，治疗选择有限。尽管代谢重编程是癌症的一个标志，但大多数研究聚焦于葡萄糖和氨基酸代谢的细胞内在改变，相对较少关注癌细胞如何感知和响应细胞外脂质可用性。在此，通过在脂蛋白剥夺条件下进行无偏转录组和circRNA谱筛选，我们鉴定出circCTCF——一种源自CTCF基因的环状RNA——作为TNBC中脂质代谢和增殖的脂蛋白响应性调控因子。circCTCF在脂质剥夺后显著下调，其缺失会损害细胞生长并促进脂滴积累。相反，circCTCF过表达增强增殖并抑制脂质储存。机制上，circCTCF通过其反向剪接连接序列结合RNA结合蛋白G3BP2，以稳定ACSL5 mRNA，从而维持ACSL5表达、磷脂酸（phosphatidic acid, PA）水平和mTOR信号。在circCTCF缺陷细胞中，ACSL5过表达可恢复PA和mTOR活性，建立一条线性的circCTCF-ACSL5-PA-mTOR轴。此外，circCTCF在热休克下与G3BP2阳性应激颗粒结合，提示该代谢轴与应激诱导的RNA调控网络之间存在潜在联系。总之，这些发现将circCTCF确立为连接细胞外脂质信号与细胞内代谢控制的关键节点，并确定circCTCF-ACSL5-PA-mTOR轴是TNBC中一个潜在的治疗脆弱点。

documents.title: Allele-specific chromatin architecture shapes imprinted domains and coordinates a distal enhancer and antisense transcription at the mouse Mest-Copg2 domain.
meta: Bae, Bongmin; Gu, Katherine; Loftus, Daniel; Whipple, Amanda J
documents.summary: 该文研究小鼠Mest-Copg2印记域中等位基因特异性染色质结构如何调控印记基因表达，与cpcdh基因家族在印记调控机制上具有高度相关性，可借鉴其三维基因组分析方法。
documents.abstract: Genomic imprinting results in parent-of-origin-dependent gene expression, but how three-dimensional genome organization contributes to imprinted gene regulation remains unclear. Using Capture Hi-C in mouse cortex and primary cortical neurons, we identified parental allele-specific chromatin architectures across multiple imprinted domains. These architectures largely originate from imprinting control regions and correlate with DNA methylation-sensitive CTCF binding. Active and inactive alleles of imprinted genes show distinct promoter interaction profiles and differential engagement with distal regulatory elements in both contact frequency and the epigenetic state of distal regions. A CRISPR interference screen identified a distal enhancer that regulates Mest-Copg2 imprinted expression through allele-specific chromatin interactions. In neurons, this enhancer activates Copg2 on the maternal allele, whereas on the paternal allele it drives Mest isoforms transcribed antisense to Copg2 and contributes to Copg2 repression. In summary, we show that allele-specific chromatin architecture coordinates maternal enhancer activity and paternal antisense transcription to control imprinted expression in neurons. 基因组印记导致基因表达具有亲本来源依赖性，但三维基因组组织如何参与印记基因调控仍不清楚。通过在小鼠皮层和原代皮层神经元中使用Capture Hi-C技术，我们鉴定了多个印记结构域中亲本等位基因特异性的染色质结构。这些结构主要起源于印记控制区，并与DNA甲基化敏感的CTCF结合相关。印记基因的活性等位基因和非活性等位基因在启动子相互作用谱上表现出差异，并且在接触频率和远端区域的表观遗传状态上，与远端调控元件的结合程度也不同。CRISPR干扰筛选鉴定出一个远端增强子，该增强子通过等位基因特异性染色质相互作用调控Mest-Copg2印记表达。在神经元中，该增强子在母本等位基因上激活Copg2，而在父本等位基因上则驱动与Copg2反义转录的Mest异构体，并参与Copg2的抑制。总之，我们表明等位基因特异性染色质结构协调母本增强子活性和父本反义转录，以控制神经元中的印记表达。

documents.title: Preliminary analysis of chromatin accessibility in osteosarcoma tissues.
documents.summary: 该研究通过ATAC-seq分析骨肉瘤染色质可及性，关注AP-1家族转录因子，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联。
documents.abstract: Osteosarcoma (OS) is highly invasive, metastatic, and lacks effective therapies, leading to poor prognosis. This study aims to dissect the core epigenetic features of OS from the perspective of chromatin accessibility to elucidate its pathogenesis and identify novel therapeutic targets. ATAC-seq was used to map the global chromatin accessibility profiles of OS tissues versus normal controls. We identified OS-specific aberrantly accessible chromatin regions and delineated enriched transcription factor binding motifs. Key transcription factors were validated by Western blotting and flow cytometry. Notably, in regions with enhanced accessibility, the binding probability of AP-1 family members (including Atf3, Fra1, Fra2, JunB, BATF, AP-1, Jun-AP1, Bach2, and CTCF) was significantly elevated. Further analysis indicates that JunB can inhibit apoptosis of OS cells and enhance their invasive ability, suggesting that it may be related to tumor progression. Overall, JunB, as a candidate molecule with potential research value, is worthy of further verification in subsequent in vivo models and clinical samples to determine its feasibility as an intervention target for OS. 骨肉瘤（Osteosarcoma, OS）具有高度侵袭性和转移性，且缺乏有效疗法，导致预后不良。本研究旨在从染色质可及性（chromatin accessibility）角度解析OS的核心表观遗传特征，以阐明其发病机制并发现新的治疗靶点。采用ATAC-seq技术绘制OS组织与正常对照的全局染色质可及性图谱。我们鉴定了OS特异性异常可及的染色质区域，并描绘了富集的转录因子结合基序。通过Western blotting和流式细胞术验证关键转录因子。值得注意的是，在可及性增强的区域中，AP-1家族成员（包括Atf3、Fra1、Fra2、JunB、BATF、AP-1、Jun-AP1、Bach2和CTCF）的结合概率显著升高。进一步分析表明，JunB可抑制OS细胞凋亡并增强其侵袭能力，提示其可能与肿瘤进展相关。总体而言，JunB作为具有潜在研究价值的候选分子，值得在后续体内模型和临床样本中进一步验证，以确定其作为OS干预靶点的可行性。

documents.title: CTCF aligns single-cell TAD-like domain boundaries and stabilizes long-range active chromatin clusters.
meta: Chen, Ziyin; Li, Xuan; Dai, Yunpeng; Shao, Kaiwen; Sun, Haolun; Wu, Nan; Yan, Jian; Zhang, Yanxiao; Yu, Miao
documents.summary: 该研究通过单细胞HiRES技术揭示CTCF缺失如何影响TAD边界稳定性和长距离活性染色质簇，与cpcdh基因家族在染色质结构调控中的潜在角色高度相关。
documents.abstract: CCCTC-binding factor (CTCF) is a key architectural protein in the three-dimensional (3D) genome, yet how its loss reshapes chromatin structure and transcription at single-cell resolution remains unclear. Using HiRES, which jointly profiles chromatin contacts and RNA from the same nucleus, we examined genome-wide effects of CTCF depletion. Topologically associating domain (TAD)-like domains (TLDs) across single cells remained largely unchanged in number and size after CTCF loss, but their boundaries became more variably positioned, and pseudobulk analyses revealed reduced interactions within A compartments. We also developed SALTAFinder to identify Spatially Aggregated Long-distance TLD Assemblies (SALTAs), clusters of TLDs occupying shared 3D space within single cells. A subset of SALTAs is enriched for highly expressed genes and super-enhancers and declines upon CTCF depletion. This structural reorganization coincided with a global reduction in per-cell RNA output, as indicated by HiRES and orthogonal measurements. Together, these findings suggest that CTCF contributes to the coordinated regulation of chromatin organization and transcriptional capacity and is associated with stabilization of long-range active chromatin clusters. CCCTC结合因子（CTCF）是三维（3D）基因组中的关键结构蛋白，但其缺失如何在单细胞分辨率下重塑染色质结构和转录仍不清楚。利用HiRES（同时从同一细胞核中分析染色质接触和RNA的方法），我们研究了CTCF缺失对全基因组的影响。在CTCF缺失后，单细胞中的拓扑关联结构域（TAD）样结构域（TLDs）在数量和大小上基本保持不变，但其边界位置变得更加可变，且伪批量分析显示A区室内的相互作用减少。我们还开发了SALTAFinder，用于识别空间聚集的长距离TLD组装体（SALTAs），即单细胞中共享3D空间的TLD簇。部分SALTAs富集了高表达基因和超级增强子，并在CTCF缺失后减少。这种结构重组与每个细胞RNA输出的整体下降同时发生，如HiRES和正交测量所示。综合来看，这些发现表明CTCF有助于染色质组织和转录能力的协调调控，并与长距离活性染色质簇的稳定化相关。
